karty.priklad: Mae hi'n annog ei phlant i siarad Cymraeg.
karty.priklad_cs: She encourages her children to speak Welsh (plant → [ph]lant after ei = her).
karty.mnemo: A warm mug of egg-NOG (an-NOG): "Go on, you can do it!"

extra.pozn: stem with one n: anogodd; annog rhywun i + soft mutation; anogaeth = encouragement (outside the coursebook); own example

karty.priklad: Eglurwch sut a pham mae cadw anifeiliaid anwes yn gwneud pobl yn hapus.
karty.priklad_cs: Explain how and why keeping pets makes people happy.
karty.mnemo: eglur = clear: egluro = to make clear.

extra.pozn: topic of the lesson (Ymarfer – Egluro); esbonio = the same, very common in the south (esboniad = explanation, L16); eglurhad = explanation (outside the coursebook); sentence from Siaradwch – Cadw anifail anwes, p. 211

karty.priklad: Cafodd y llyfr newydd ei lansio yn y siop Gymraeg leol.
karty.priklad_cs: The new book was launched in the local Welsh shop (Cymraeg → [G]ymraeg and lleol → [l]eol after the feminine siop).

extra.pozn: lansiad = launch (outside the coursebook); passive with cael (L11); own example

karty.priklad: Pam mae geiriau'n treiglo?
karty.priklad_cs: Why do words mutate?
karty.mnemo: TREIGLo ~ TRIangle: a word with three ways to change.

extra.pozn: sentence from Ymarfer – Egluro, p. 209; Help llaw p. 214: the mutation doesn't change with the contracted forms (i'w waith e, i'w champfa hi)

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n gantores adnabyddus iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: She's a very well-known singer (cantores → [g]antores after yn).
karty.mnemo: adnabod = to know → adnabyddus = known (to everyone).

extra.pozn: well-known = famous, not "an acquaintance" (that is cydnabod); own example

karty.priklad: Aethon ni i westy crand yn Llundain.
karty.priklad_cs: We went to a posh hotel in London (gwesty → [w]esty after i).

extra.pozn: synonym moethus = luxurious (L9); own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n hoffi celf gyfoes.
karty.priklad_cs: I like contemporary art (cyfoes → [g]yfoes after the feminine celf).
karty.mnemo: cyf- (together) + oes (age, era): of the same age = contemporary.

extra.pozn: materion cyfoes = current affairs (L2); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r llyfrgell gyhoeddus ar gau heddiw.
karty.priklad_cs: The public library is closed today (cyhoeddus → [g]yhoeddus after the feminine llyfrgell).
karty.mnemo: cyhoeddi = to announce, to publish: what's announced is public.

extra.pozn: cyhoeddi = to announce, to publish (outside the Geirfa); own example

karty.priklad: Mae ei gŵr hi'n ddi-Gymraeg, ond mae e'n dysgu.
karty.priklad_cs: Her husband doesn't speak Welsh, but he's learning (di-Gymraeg → [dd]i-Gymraeg after yn).

extra.pozn: the Geirfa explains it in Welsh: ddim yn siarad Cymraeg; the prefix di- = without, and it causes soft mutation (Cymraeg → Gymraeg); own example

sever.priklad: Mae ei gŵr hi'n ddi-Gymraeg, ond mae o'n dysgu.
sever.priklad_cs: Her husband doesn't speak Welsh, but he's learning (di-Gymraeg → [dd]i-Gymraeg after yn).

karty.priklad: Oes bwyd figan ar y fwydlen?
karty.priklad_cs: Is there vegan food on the menu? (bwydlen → [f]wydlen after y, feminine)

extra.pozn: f- doesn't mutate; based on Byw yn wyrdd, p. 202 (bwyd llysieuol/figan); own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n trio bwyta mwy o fwyd llysieuol.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm trying to eat more vegetarian food (bwyd → [f]wyd after o).

extra.pozn: llysieuwr / llysieuwraig = vegetarian (man / woman) (outside the coursebook); based on Byw yn wyrdd, p. 202

karty.priklad: Dw i'n prynu ffrwythau, llysiau, bara ac yn y blaen.
karty.priklad_cs: I buy fruit, vegetables, bread and so on.
karty.mnemo: blaen = front: "and on to the front".

extra.pozn: ac ati = the same, shorter (p. 202); own example

karty.priklad: Cymru sy ar y blaen ar hanner amser.
karty.priklad_cs: Wales are in the lead at half time.
karty.mnemo: blaen = front: you're at the front.

extra.pozn: o flaen = in front of (L2); emphatic sentence with sy (L13); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r plant yn chwarae lawr llawr.
karty.priklad_cs: The children are playing downstairs.
karty.mnemo: (i) lawr = down + llawr = floor: down on the ground floor.

extra.pozn: opposite lan llofft = upstairs (outside the coursebook); grisiau = stairs; llawr gwaelod = ground floor (L9); own example

sever.priklad: Mae'r plant yn chwarae lawr grisiau.
sever.pozn: north: lawr grisiau instead of lawr llawr (outside the coursebook)

karty.cs: off, from (on top of), down from
karty.priklad: Cymerais i'r allwedd oddi ar fwrdd y gegin.
karty.priklad_cs: I took the key off the kitchen table (bwrdd → [f]wrdd after oddi ar; cegin → [g]egin after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: ar = on; oddi ar = off (what was on it).

extra.tvary: oddi arna i, oddi arnat ti, oddi arno fe, oddi arni hi, oddi arnon ni, oddi arnoch chi, oddi arnyn nhw
extra.pozn: preposition; forms like ar; oddi cartre = away from home (L3); allwedd (f) = key, De/Gogledd p. 214; own example

sever.priklad: Cymerais i'r goriad oddi ar fwrdd y gegin.
sever.priklad_cs: I took the key off the kitchen table (bwrdd → [f]wrdd after oddi ar; cegin → [g]egin after y, feminine).
sever.pozn: north: goriad (m) instead of allwedd (f) (L16, p. 214)

karty.priklad: Mae'n fater o synnwyr cyffredin.
karty.priklad_cs: It's a matter of common sense (mater → [f]ater after 'n).

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; masculine because of synnwyr; synhwyrol = sensible (outside the coursebook); own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n mynd ar gwrs undydd ddydd Sadwrn.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm going on a one-day course on Saturday (cwrs → [g]wrs after ar; dydd → [dd]ydd as an adverb of time).

extra.pozn: goes after the noun it describes (cwrs undydd, gŵyl undydd); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r llun uwchben y lle tân.
karty.priklad_cs: The picture is above the fireplace.

extra.tvary: uwch fy mhen i, uwch dy ben di, uwch ei ben e, uwch ei phen hi, uwch ein pennau ni, uwch eich pennau chi, uwch eu pennau nhw
extra.pozn: with a personal pronoun it splits: uwch fy mhen i (like ar ben, L8); uchod = above (in a text, L13); lle tân = fireplace (L9); own example

karty.priklad: Fydd hi'n braf yfory? Gawn ni weld.
karty.priklad_cs: Will it be fine tomorrow? We'll see (cawn → [g]awn; gweld → [w]eld after ni).
karty.mnemo: cael (to get) + gweld (to see): "we'll get to see".

extra.pozn: phrase from Robin Radio, p. 213; colloquially also fory instead of yfory; own example

karty.priklad: Diolch am bopeth, a siwrnai dda i chi!
karty.priklad_cs: Thanks for everything, and have a good journey! (popeth → [b]opeth after am; da → [dd]a after the feminine siwrnai)

extra.pozn: phrase from Robin Radio, p. 213; to one person you know well: Siwrnai dda i ti!; siwrne = colloquial spelling (see 0641); own example
